relationships.evidence_quote: Preliminary quantification of human DRG tissue samples revealed that approximately 75% of MR-IR neurons also expressed TRPV1, 64% co-expressed Nav1.8, and 60% co-expressed TrkA (Figure 3B).

key_findings: MR, 11β-HSD2, aldosterone and CYP11B2 are expressed in human DRG neurons and colocalize with CGRP, TRPV1, Nav1.8 and TrkA (two donors).
Intrathecal aldosterone synthase inhibition in rats reduced DRG aldosterone, downregulated CGRP, TRPV1, TrkA and Nav1.8 mRNA, and reversed inflammatory hyperalgesia.
